column2: relocated docs lack positive existence pins while runtime deletions are only optionally asserted. the firm plan mandates `docs/attic/dialectic-legacy.md` and `docs/summary-comment-template.md`, and updates `skills/shared/dialectic-protocol.md` plus `docs/run-logs.md` to point at them. `test-implement-structure.sh` only requires the old `skills/implement/references/{summary-comment-template,pr-body-template}.md` files to exist today; after removal from that list, `make test-implement-structure` still passes if the docs copies are never created, leaving new authoritative pointers at broken paths.
